newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European Commission expected to allow Boeing and McDonnell Douglas to go ahead with merger project after Boeing renounced exclusive supply contracts with three U.S. airlines.
-- 92 percent of workers at Renault's Vilvoorde, Belgium assembly plant in vote approve terms of layoff plan to accompany a planned shutdown of the plant.

-- European Commission investigating some 3.5 billion francs in financial aid the paper says was granted by the German government to oil group Elf to build an oil refinery in Leuna, Germany. French judges are also investigating alleged related commissions that may have reached up to 300 million francs.

-- Farm minister Louis Le Pensec calls on Europe not to lower its guard against the United States, says European Commission project on a reform of its common agricultural policy ought to be "seriously reviewed".
